observations.finding: Native capture review combines these controls for both media types.
Timed captures made the photographer wait even when ready. The voice option needs on-device recognition and microphone access.
Instructions travel with the capture request into the native viewfinder.
The capture flow uses the chosen style and accepted inputs to start one generation run.
The flow test checks that speech and artwork requests both wait for reveal.
The portal teardown calls the same cancellation path as Stop.
A failed table write leaves the result readable and produces one generation call.
The four-step flow test checks that each completed capture gives way to the next action and an early reveal tap immediately shows progress while work continues.
